faq_heading: Homes near Ellendale Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Ellendale Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Ellendale Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Ellendale Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Ellendale Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 39 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,080,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Ellendale Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Ellendale Elementary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 13% of sales above the list price for the 39 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Ellendale Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Guildford Park Secondary (0.7 km south) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (0.8 km south).

Ellendale Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 14525 110a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Ellendale Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Ellendale Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Ellendale Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Ellendale Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 39 homes sold within 1 km of Ellendale Elementary: 39 houses. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,080,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Ellendale Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Ellendale Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 4 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Ecole Riverdale Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kwantlen Park Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Guildford Park Secondary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Iqra School (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (0.8 km south), Holly Elementary (1.2 km south-east), Iqra School (1.2 km north), Hjorth Road Elementary (1.4 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ecole Riverdale Elementary, 0.7 km south-east of Ellendale Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Ellendale Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Ellendale Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Ellendale Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Ellendale Elementary was $1,080,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Ecole Riverdale Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-east of Ellendale Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
